title: Final Answer High T
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for specific heat at high temperature must be correctly stated as C_v approximately N k_B.

title: Final Answer Low T
description: Essential Criteria - The expression for specific heat at low temperature must be correctly stated as C_v approximately (pi^2/3)(Nk_B T/Theta_D).

title: Correct Use of Frequencies
description: Important Criteria - The derivation must correctly utilize the normal mode frequencies omega_k in the context of the Debye model.

title: Temperature Limits
description: Important Criteria - The response should clearly address the two temperature limits T to infinity and T to zero.

title: Physical Constants
description: Optional Criteria - The response should appropriately define and use physical constants such as k_B and Theta_D.

title: Mathematical Derivations
description: Important Criteria - The derivation should include necessary mathematical steps leading to the final expressions.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - Watch for common sign mistakes in the derivation of the specific heat expressions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria - Ensure that units are consistent throughout the derivation and final answers.
